chatWithCopilot.label: Chat with Copilot
chatWithCopilot.description: Send a message to an existing Copilot conversation or creating a new one and get a response

conversationId.label: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: The ID of an existing conversation. If not provided, a new conversation will be created.

timeZone.label: Time Zone
timeZone.description: User location time zone in IANA format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London)

searchCopilot.label: Search Copilot
searchCopilot.description: Perform hybrid (semantic and lexical) search across OneDrive for work or school content using natural language queries

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Natural language query to search for relevant files. Maximum 1,500 characters.

filterExpression.label: Filter Expression (Optional)
filterExpression.description: KQL filter expression for OneDrive data source (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/dev/general-development/keyword-query-language-kql-syntax-reference). Example: path:"https://contoso-my.sharepoint.com/personal/user/Documents/"

resourceMetadata.label: Resource Metadata Names (Optional)
resourceMetadata.description: Array of metadata field names to include in results. Example: ["title", "author"]
